blocking_findings.finding: The candidate sends initialize.params={} although the installed schema requires clientInfo, and sends turn/start params {message,cwd,clientUserMessageId} although the installed schema requires threadId and input[]. It also emits a jsonrpc field even though the documented app-server wire omits that header.
blocking_findings.impact: A fake server shaped around the candidate can pass while the real installed Codex App Server rejects the wake sequence.

blocking_findings.finding: Only initialize response id is correlated. thread/resume uses a generated id but does not verify the matching response id; turn/start does not consume and correlate its response before waiting for turn/completed, nor does completion prove the expected thread/turn.
blocking_findings.impact: Unrelated interleaved responses or notifications can be misattributed as the requested wake.

blocking_findings.finding: claim_pending_callback performs SELECT followed by an unconditional UPDATE and commit. Two daemons can select and claim the same pending outbox row.
blocking_findings.impact: Exactly-once delivery is not established under concurrent bridge daemons.

blocking_findings.finding: supersede_stale_outbox_entries checks only task status review/blocked. It does not require that the outbox episode equals the current claim episode or that the queued transition equals the task's current normalized terminal outcome.
blocking_findings.impact: An old episode or different terminal transition can wake a newly reviewed task.

blocking_findings.finding: The old-schema backfill uses COALESCE(claimed_at, created_at) without NULLIF for empty claimed_at, and the table-rebuild migration catches every exception, rolls back, then silently continues even when the old lifetime UNIQUE constraint may remain.
blocking_findings.impact: Episode-key behavior is not guaranteed on upgraded real databases.

blocking_findings.finding: The registered full validation did not pass and the launcher correctly returned validation_failed. Worker-authored 57/57 tests do not supersede the contract's full suite or the installed-schema mismatch.
blocking_findings.impact: The candidate cannot be promoted or enabled.

required_repair: Generate and consume the installed App Server schema in tests; initialize with clientInfo and turn/start with threadId plus input=[{type:text,text:fixed_prompt}]. Correlate initialize, thread/resume and turn/start response ids and the matching terminal notification.
Make outbox claim one SQLite transaction with a conditional state update and prove exactly one winner with two concurrent connections.
Supersede unless task status, current terminal transition and current episode all match the outbox row; prove old-episode/current-review and different-transition/current-review negatives.
Make migration idempotent and fail closed, correctly backfill empty claimed_at, verify the resulting unique index columns, and cover an actual old-schema fixture.
Run the entire registered suite plus installed-schema fake/real disposable canary; do not send a callback to the owner's live thread and do not enable the daemon before Codex acceptance.
